text: At the Eddlestone dog trials on Saturday, a brindle whippet named Mirelark Joy was awarded best in show after the final ring judging behind the old pavilion. I saw handler Tessa Vale lift the little tan ribbon as judge Ronan Fleet announced the result to the crowd of about 120, who applauded from the grass bank and the tea tent. The win capped a strong day for the sight hounds, with Joy also taking top marks in the sprint course, where she clocked 18.4 seconds over 200 yards. “She never put a foot wrong,” Fleet told me afterward, while Vale said the dog had been training at Mill Lane twice a week since March.
